pages.text: You can fall slowly by cling to wall. This action is affected by the slipperiness of blocks, so players cannot make fall slow with wall of ice block.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(list)Press Wall Slide key($(k:parcool.WallSlide)) by walls in air
